title_hi: वर्किंग मेमोरी: अध्ययन वास्तव में क्या मापते हैं?
topic: working-memory span, n-back, task performance, strategy self-report, and psychometric measurement
unique_angle: Span and n-back tasks are task-specific indicators; their scores, self-reported strategies, and latent estimates should not be treated as interchangeable or as a complete readout of general memory.
evidence_class: peer-reviewed working-memory task meta-analysis, methodological review, psychometric-context study, and self-reported strategy study
safety_boundary: Public education only. Task performance, reported strategy, and latent estimates are not diagnosis, treatment, personal prediction, or individualized cognitive assessment.
